selection.groupHashRequirement: sha256 of de-identified subject/source-equivalence group; near-duplicates and same capture session must share one groupHash

leakageControls: No development image, silver textbook crop, training sample, perturbation/augmentation of a development image, or previously tuned image may enter the mentor holdout.
All correlated or near-duplicate captures must share one groupHash.
Mentor labels must be locked before candidate observations are joined.
Mentor annotation must not expose candidate/model output.
Candidate observations must be generated from one declared candidateVersion.
Image SHA-256 must match exactly across holdout membership, mentor label, and candidate observation.
metricSemantics: agreement with independent structured mentor observations; not clinical diagnostic accuracy
